title: [29.X]-"Your license does not grant you the following permissions on TableData 17 G/L Entry: Modify" if you Update Registers from G/L Registers page for old entries with G/L Register No. = 0.
summary: Fixes a missing Modify permission error on G/L Entry (table 17) when users run Update Registers from the G/L Registers page for old entries with G/L Register No. = 0. The change is in the G/L Register table in the W1, ES and APAC layers.
key_points: Running Update Registers from the G/L Registers page no longer fails with a G/L Entry Modify permission error
Affects old entries where G/L Register No. is 0
G/L Register table updated in the W1, ES and APAC layers
